claims.quote: The Pacific blue-eye, Pseudomugil signifer, is the most widely-distributed blue-eye in Australia, found along most of the eastern coastline.

regions.name: Cape York Peninsula
regions.quote: Its range extends along the majority of the country's eastern coastline, southwards from the Cape York Peninsula in northern Queensland state to Merimbula Lake in southern New South Wales, near the border with Victoria state.

regions.name: Torres Strait
regions.quote: There exist populations on some offshore islands, including those in the Torres Strait, while it's also known from the western side of the Cape York Peninsula in the Embley and Mission river systems.
